evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall require all users to register for a new account or log in to an existing account at app startup before granting access to app features.

issues.explanation: The phrase is broad and may be interpreted differently unless the protected feature scope is defined elsewhere. A verifier may not know whether splash screens, help pages, or legal notices count as app features.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall require each user to register a new account or log in to an existing account at app startup before granting access to any authenticated application function.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide a registration and login workflow within the mobile app startup experience for supported Android and iOS devices.

issues.explanation: This combines two distinct capabilities—registration and login—into one requirement. Each should be specified separately for singularity and easier verification.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide a user registration workflow during application startup on supported Android and iOS devices.

issues.explanation: The phrase is product-design language rather than a precise trigger or condition. It weakens the standard requirement structure by not clearly identifying when the workflow is presented.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall present the user registration workflow during application startup on supported Android and iOS devices.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall allow authenticated users to select, save, and update favorite clubs and preferred sports channels as personalization preferences.

issues.detected_issue: select, save, and update favorite clubs and preferred sports channels
issues.explanation: The requirement bundles multiple actions and two preference types into one statement. This creates more than one requirement and complicates verification.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow an authenticated user to save favorite clubs as personalization preferences.

issues.detected_issue: favorite clubs and preferred sports channels
issues.explanation: The structure does not clearly separate the managed data objects. Separate requirements would improve traceability and test coverage.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow an authenticated user to update saved sports channel preferences.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall use each user’s saved favorite clubs and preferred sports channels to tailor the football content presented in the app.

issues.explanation: The verb is subjective and does not define the specific adaptation behavior. Different implementers may interpret personalization differently.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall filter displayed football content using each user’s saved favorite clubs and preferred sports channels.

issues.detected_issue: tailor the football content presented in the app
issues.explanation: The required system behavior is not measurable because no rule defines what content must be included, excluded, or prioritized.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display football news items only when they match at least one of the user’s saved favorite clubs or selected sports channels.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall display current football news items related to the user’s favorite teams and filtered by the user’s selected sports channels.

issues.explanation: The term is vague because it does not define a time window or freshness threshold for news items.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display football news items published within the previous 24 hours that relate to the user’s favorite teams and match the user’s selected sports channels.

issues.detected_issue: related to the user’s favorite teams and filtered by the user’s selected sports channels
issues.explanation: This imposes two selection criteria in one statement. They may be valid together, but they represent distinct filtering rules that are easier to verify separately.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display football news items that relate to the user’s favorite teams.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide access to football content covering national and international leagues and competitions supported by the app’s data sources.

issues.explanation: The content type is not defined. It could mean news, scores, standings, videos, or other media.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide access to match results, standings, and news for leagues and competitions supported by the application's configured data sources.

issues.detected_issue: supported by the app’s data sources
issues.explanation: The requirement depends on an external and potentially changing scope without a defined list or configuration baseline, making verification unclear.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide access to match results, standings, and news for each league and competition listed in the approved data-source configuration.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide users with detailed team information and detailed player information on demand through the app interface.

issues.detected_issue: detailed team information and detailed player information
issues.explanation: This contains two separate information-access capabilities and should be split into separate requirements.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display team information on demand through the application interface.

issues.explanation: The adjective is subjective and does not define which fields must be shown.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display team information including team name, league, position, recent results, and roster on demand through the application interface.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide an integrated live ticker that retrieves current match data from an external API and displays live results and match events for users’ selected teams.

issues.detected_issue: retrieves current match data from an external API and displays live results and match events
issues.explanation: This joins data retrieval and user display behavior in one requirement. These are separate behaviors and should be isolated.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall retrieve match data for each user-selected team from the external live-data API.

issues.explanation: The phrase is descriptive but not behaviorally precise. It does not define what live ticker functionality consists of.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display a live ticker view for each user-selected team.

issues.explanation: The term does not define allowable data age or refresh latency.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall retrieve match data with a maximum source-data age of 30 seconds from the external live-data API.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall continuously refresh the live ticker display with updated match data received from the external server while network connectivity is available.

issues.explanation: This is vague because it does not specify a refresh interval or maximum delay between updates.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall refresh the live ticker display at least once every 30 seconds while network connectivity is available.

issues.explanation: The phrase does not define the freshness threshold or update criteria.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall refresh the live ticker display when new match data is received from the external server, with a maximum display latency of 5 seconds.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall present live stream access as deep links to approved external broadcast providers rather than playing streams directly inside the app.

issues.explanation: The approval basis is undefined unless a controlled provider list exists elsewhere. Verification requires a specific source of truth.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall present live stream access as deep links only to broadcast providers listed in the approved provider configuration.

issues.detected_issue: as deep links ... rather than playing streams directly inside the app
issues.explanation: This includes both a positive behavior and a prohibition. While related, they are more clearly specified as separate requirements.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall present live stream access as a deep link to an approved external broadcast provider.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall display a live stream link for a match only after the corresponding live broadcast has begun and the external provider link is available.

issues.explanation: The trigger may be interpreted differently unless tied to a provider status signal or scheduled start event.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display a live stream link for a match only when the external provider reports the broadcast status as live and a valid provider URL is available.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall evaluate country-based broadcast-rights availability before displaying a live stream link and shall suppress the link when rights are not valid in the user’s country.

issues.detected_issue: evaluate ... before displaying a live stream link and shall suppress the link
issues.explanation: This contains a decision process and a resulting display behavior in one statement. Separating them improves testability and traceability.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall suppress a live stream link when broadcast rights are not valid in the user’s country.

issues.explanation: The term 'valid' is ambiguous without a defined rights-status source or rule.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall suppress a live stream link when the rights service indicates that the match is not licensed for the user’s country.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall allow authenticated users to explicitly opt in to notifications before sending any push notifications.
The system shall send notifications about news and results related to a user’s favorite teams only when that user has opted in to notifications.

issues.explanation: This covers two notification content categories in one requirement. They may merit separate requirements if independently configurable or testable.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall send news notifications related to a user’s favorite teams only when that user has opted in to notifications.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide a function for users to share news items and match reports through the mobile device’s available social media sharing options.

issues.detected_issue: share news items and match reports
issues.explanation: This specifies two shareable content types in one requirement. Separate requirements improve singularity.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow a user to share a news item through the mobile device’s native sharing interface.

issues.explanation: The phrase depends on the device and installed applications and does not precisely define the system behavior.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall invoke the mobile device’s native sharing interface for a selected news item.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall make the app ready for use within a maximum of two seconds after startup under normal supported operating conditions.

issues.detected_issue: make the app ready for use within a maximum of two seconds
issues.explanation: This is a performance constraint, not a functional behavior, so it is miscategorized as a functional requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall be ready for user interaction within 2 seconds of application startup under defined normal operating conditions.

issues.explanation: The operating conditions are not defined, so the test environment is unclear.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall be ready for user interaction within 2 seconds of application startup on supported devices connected to a network with at least the minimum supported bandwidth and latency.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall preserve usability during limited or lost network connectivity by allowing access to previously cached content and saved user preferences while offline.

issues.explanation: This is subjective and can be interpreted in many ways. It does not identify measurable system behavior.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide offline access to previously cached content and saved user preferences during loss of network connectivity.

issues.explanation: The phrase is vague because it does not define the network states or thresholds covered.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide offline access to previously cached content and saved user preferences when no network connection is available.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall maintain a consistent user interface and fixed app modules even when externally sourced server data is updated.

issues.detected_issue: consistent user interface and fixed app modules
issues.explanation: This combines interface consistency and module stability, which are distinct qualities.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall preserve the layout structure of fixed application modules when externally sourced server data is updated.

issues.explanation: The term 'consistent' is subjective and not measurable without explicit rules.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall preserve the position and labels of navigation controls when externally sourced server data is updated.

issues.explanation: The term is unclear because it does not define which modules are fixed or what stability means.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall keep the Home, News, Live Ticker, Favorites, and Settings modules available when server data is refreshed.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall support up to 100,000 simultaneous users on peak match days without functional performance loss.

issues.explanation: This is a scalability/performance constraint, not a functional requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall support 100,000 concurrent users during peak match days while meeting defined response-time and error-rate thresholds.

issues.explanation: The phrase is vague because it does not define measurable acceptance criteria for performance degradation.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall support 100,000 concurrent users during peak match days with a 95th-percentile response time of 2 seconds or less for core user actions and an error rate below 1%.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall process personal data related to registration, authentication, personalization, and notifications in compliance with GDPR.

issues.explanation: This references a broad legal framework rather than specific verifiable system behavior. It is not directly testable as written.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall record a timestamp, user identifier, and consent status for each user's notification opt-in action.

issues.explanation: The requirement spans multiple processing contexts and likely multiple legal obligations. These should be decomposed into specific requirements.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall store only the personal data elements defined for user registration in the approved data model.

issues.detected_issue: process personal data ... in compliance with GDPR
issues.explanation: This is a regulatory constraint and should be expressed as a set of measurable non-functional/privacy requirements rather than one broad functional statement.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall enforce privacy controls defined in the approved GDPR compliance specification for each personal-data processing function.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide users with in-app access to information required for GDPR-compliant personal data processing, including privacy-related notices relevant to app use.

issues.detected_issue: information required for GDPR-compliant personal data processing
issues.explanation: This is legally broad and unspecified. The exact information to display is not identified.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display the privacy notice, data-processing purposes, data categories, retention period, and contact information for the data controller within the application.

issues.detected_issue: privacy-related notices relevant to app use
issues.explanation: The phrase 'relevant' is vague and subjective.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide an in-app privacy notice screen accessible from the Settings menu.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall capture and make available user feedback and app review information for ongoing evaluation by product and support stakeholders.

issues.explanation: This includes two separate behaviors: collecting feedback data and providing access to it.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall store submitted user feedback and imported app review records in the feedback repository.

issues.explanation: This phrase is non-specific and does not define frequency, users, or access method.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide authorized product and support users with read access to stored user feedback and app review records through an administrative interface.

issues.detected_issue: for ongoing evaluation by product and support stakeholders
issues.explanation: This expresses a business purpose rather than a system behavior. The requirement should focus on what the system must do.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide authorized stakeholders with access to stored user feedback and app review data.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall load and be fully ready for user interaction within 2 seconds of app startup on supported Android and iOS devices under normal operating conditions.

issues.detected_issue: load and be fully ready for user interaction
issues.explanation: This contains two potentially different completion criteria. A single measurable readiness condition should be used.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall be ready for user interaction within 2 seconds of application startup on supported Android and iOS devices under defined operating conditions.

issues.explanation: The test environment is undefined, making verification inconsistent.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall be ready for user interaction within 2 seconds of application startup on supported Android and iOS devices when CPU utilization, memory availability, and network conditions are within the defined performance test profile.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall support up to 100,000 concurrent users during peak match-day periods without performance loss that prevents users from accessing core features, including authentication, news viewing, live ticker updates, notifications, and deep-link access to eligible live streams.

issues.explanation: This is vague because it does not define measurable thresholds such as response time, throughput, or error rate.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall support 100,000 concurrent users during peak match-day periods with a 95th-percentile response time of 2 seconds or less and an error rate below 1% for core features.

issues.explanation: Although examples are listed, the acceptance boundary is still unclear unless the monitored transactions are explicitly defined.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall support 100,000 concurrent users during peak match-day periods while maintaining the specified response-time and error-rate thresholds for authentication, news viewing, live ticker updates, notification delivery, and deep-link generation.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall retrieve and display live ticker data in real time from the external API and shall continuously refresh current match data while network connectivity is available.

issues.detected_issue: retrieve and display live ticker data ... and shall continuously refresh
issues.explanation: This combines retrieval, display, and refresh behaviors in one statement.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall refresh displayed live ticker data at least once every 30 seconds while network connectivity is available.

issues.explanation: This phrase is vague unless a measurable latency is specified.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display live ticker data within 5 seconds of receiving an update from the external API.

issues.explanation: No refresh interval or maximum delay is specified.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall request updated live ticker data from the external API at least once every 30 seconds while network connectivity is available.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall remain usable under limited network coverage and shall continue to provide offline access to previously loaded content and saved user preferences during temporary loss of connectivity.

issues.detected_issue: remain usable ... and shall continue to provide offline access
issues.explanation: This combines a subjective usability objective with a concrete offline-access behavior.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide offline access to previously loaded content and saved user preferences during temporary loss of connectivity.

issues.explanation: The term is subjective and not measurable.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow users to view previously loaded content and saved user preferences when network connectivity is unavailable.

issues.explanation: This does not define a measurable network state or threshold.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide cached content access when the device has no network connection.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall maintain a consistent user interface and stable operation of fixed app modules even when external server data or updates are received.

issues.detected_issue: consistent user interface and stable operation of fixed app modules
issues.explanation: Two distinct quality expectations are combined in one requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall preserve the defined layout and navigation structure when external server data is received.

issues.explanation: Subjective and unverifiable without explicit UI rules.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall preserve the position, order, and labels of primary navigation controls when external server data is received.

issues.explanation: This phrase is vague and does not define observable pass/fail criteria.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall keep the Home, News, Live Ticker, Favorites, and Settings modules accessible during server-data refresh operations.

issues.explanation: The requirement does not define which modules are covered.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall keep the Home, News, Live Ticker, Favorites, and Settings modules accessible during receipt of external updates.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide a user interface that enables users to access core information and functions directly with uncomplicated startup registration and login flows.

issues.explanation: The phrase is broad and unspecified, so scope is unclear.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide navigation controls that allow users to access News, Live Ticker, Favorites, and Settings from the home screen.

issues.explanation: This is vague because it does not define how many steps or what path is acceptable.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow users to access News, Live Ticker, Favorites, and Settings within one tap from the home screen.

issues.explanation: This is subjective and not testable.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall present the registration form in no more than 3 screens during application startup.

issues.detected_issue: access core information and functions directly with uncomplicated startup registration and login flows
issues.explanation: The statement combines UI navigation quality and startup authentication-flow design into one requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall present a login screen during application startup.

issues.detected_issue: provide a user interface that enables users
issues.explanation: This is written as a vague usability principle rather than a measurable non-functional or concrete functional requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow users to access the News, Live Ticker, Favorites, and Settings screens from the home screen within one tap.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall display live stream links only when a live broadcast has begun and when the relevant transmission rights are valid for the user’s country.

issues.explanation: The decision source for rights validity is not identified, which may cause implementation variance.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display a live stream link only when the provider reports the broadcast status as live and the rights service reports that the stream is licensed for the user’s country.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall process all personal data in compliance with GDPR across registration, login, personalization, notifications, and ongoing app usage.

issues.explanation: This is a broad legal objective that cannot be directly verified without decomposing it into specific controls and behaviors.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall record user consent status and timestamp before processing personal data for push notifications.

issues.detected_issue: registration, login, personalization, notifications, and ongoing app usage
issues.explanation: This spans multiple processing activities and likely multiple requirements.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall process personal data used for registration in accordance with the approved data-retention and consent rules.

issues.explanation: This phrase is broad and undefined, making the requirement scope unclear.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall apply the approved privacy controls to personal data collected during authenticated application sessions.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall send notifications about news and results only to users who have explicitly opted in to receive such notifications.

issues.explanation: Two notification categories are combined. If they are configured or tested independently, they should be separated.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall send news notifications only to users who have explicitly opted in to receive notifications.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall preserve the availability of detailed team and player information for user access at any time, subject to network availability or cached offline data where applicable.

issues.explanation: This combines two separate information domains into one requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide access to team information when network data or cached data is available.

issues.explanation: This phrase is vague and does not define uptime, access condition, or expected behavior.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display team information when the data is available from the network or local cache.

issues.explanation: The adjective is subjective and does not specify required data fields.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display player information including name, club, position, and statistics when the data is available from the network or local cache.

issues.explanation: This is absolute and unrealistic unless expressed as an availability target.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall make team information available whenever the device has network access or valid cached data.

issues.explanation: This is an escape clause that leaves applicability undefined.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display cached team information when a valid cached record exists and network access is unavailable.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall undergo thorough pre-release testing and issue resolution activities to detect and correct malfunctions before production release.

issues.detected_issue: undergo thorough pre-release testing and issue resolution activities
issues.explanation: This is a project/process requirement, not a product system requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: The project shall execute the approved pre-release test plan and resolve all severity 1 and severity 2 defects before production release.

issues.explanation: This is subjective and not measurable.
issues.suggested_fix: The project shall execute all test cases defined in the approved pre-release test plan before production release.

issues.explanation: A system cannot meaningfully perform testing activities on itself in the product-requirement sense. The actor and artifact are misidentified.
issues.suggested_fix: The verification team shall execute the approved pre-release test plan before production release.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall support continuous post-release evaluation of user feedback and app reviews to inform ongoing functional and service quality improvements.

issues.explanation: This phrase is vague and does not define frequency, method, or measurable behavior.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide authorized stakeholders with access to collected user feedback and app review records after release.

issues.detected_issue: to inform ongoing functional and service quality improvements
issues.explanation: This is a business objective, not a direct system behavior.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall export collected user feedback and app review data in CSV format for authorized stakeholders.

issues.explanation: The requirement does not define what specific capability the system must provide to enable evaluation.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall store user feedback submissions and imported app review records and make them searchable by date and rating for authorized users.
